description: Source file containing utility functions for managing UCI configurations and UBUS communication in the bbf.config daemon, including functions for calling UBUS methods, reloading services, and applying UCI configuration changes.

methods.name: void strncpyt(char * dst,const char * src,size_t n)
methods.description: Safely copies up to n-1 characters from src to dst, null-terminating the result.

methods.name: int bbf_config_call(struct ubus_context * ctx,const char * object,const char * method,struct blob_buf * data,ubus_data_handler_t callback,void * arg)
methods.description: Performs UBUS call to invoke a method on a specific UBUS object, handling lookup by object name and invoking with provided data and callback.

methods.name: void reload_service(struct ubus_context * ctx,const char * config_name,bool is_commit)
methods.description: Reloads a specific UCI configuration by committing or reverting changes.

methods.name: void reload_specified_services(struct ubus_context * ctx,const char * conf_dir,const char * save_dir,struct blob_attr * services,bool is_commit,bool reload)
methods.description: Iterates over a list of services, applies UCI commit or revert, and optionally reloads each service.

methods.name: void reload_all_services(struct ubus_context * ctx,const char * conf_dir,const char * save_dir,bool is_commit,bool reload)
methods.description: Iterates over all UCI configs, applies commit or revert, and optionally reloads all services.

methods.name: void uci_apply_changes(const char * conf_dir,const char * save_dir,bool is_commit)
methods.description: Applies UCI changes globally across all configurations by committing or reverting.

methods.name: void uci_config_changes(const char * conf_dir,const char * save_dir,struct blob_buf * bb)
methods.description: Identifies configurations with unsaved changes and adds them to a blob buffer for processing.
